metadata.title: Offer and pricing
metadata.description: The price of your product, screen by screen: from €1,500, fixed at signing, with 30 days of bug fixes.

og.title: The price of your product, screen by screen.
og.subtitle: Fixed price at signing, from €1,500.

hero.title: The price of your product, screen by screen.
hero.description: The price depends on scope: platforms, number of screens, back office and business complexity. It is fixed at signing and does not change.

plans.title: A price per screen, by platform
plans.note: A distinct view counts as one screen; its states and variants are included. Above €15,000, the price is set together during scoping.

items.title: Website or web app
items.description: €20 per screen for a static site, €14 for a simple web app, €24 for a rich interface.

items.title: Mobile
items.description: €20 per screen, iOS and Android. Publication on the App Store and Google Play included.

items.title: Back office
items.description: 1.5 times the price of a screen: content, users, orders, moderation, statistics, exports.

flow.title: Six steps, from scoping to after.

steps.title: Scoping
steps.description: Free. We define the scope: platforms, screens, back office, complexity.

steps.title: Firm quote
steps.description: The price is fixed at signing. 40% is paid then.

steps.title: Mockups
steps.description: Mockups are approved before development starts.

steps.title: Demo
steps.description: Halfway through, we present the product. 30% is paid.

steps.title: Launch
steps.description: Production release, store publication, handover of code and accounts. 30% is paid.

steps.title: After
steps.description: 30 days of bug fixes, then optional maintenance.

simulator.title: Estimate the price of your product
simulator.description: Answer a few questions about your platforms, screens and features. The estimate updates with every answer.

items.title: Showcase website
items.detail: A mockup · up to 60 web screens

items.title: First version of a SaaS
items.detail: A mockup · simple 50-screen web app · 15-screen back office

items.title: Simple mobile app
items.detail: A mockup · up to 100 mobile screens

items.title: Mobile app with back office
items.detail: A mockup · 60 mobile screens · 25-screen back office

items.title: Web and mobile product with payment
items.detail: A mockup · 40 web screens · 60 mobile screens · online payment

options.title: What adds to the price of screens
options.description: Each option appears in the simulator when you select it.

items.label: Mockups (if not provided)
items.description: €8 per screen from an idea, €6 from a specification.

items.label: Online payment
items.description: For the first integration. €22 per additional integration.

items.title: Fixed price
items.description: The price is fixed at signing, after scoping. It does not change during the project.

items.title: Paid in 3 instalments
items.description: 40% at signing, 30% at the mid-way demo, 30% at launch.

items.title: Minimum order
items.description: €1,500 for a website or web app, €2,000 as soon as mobile is involved.

items.title: Rich interface
items.description: Delivery in batches, each batch paid on delivery; batches are agreed during scoping.

items.title: Design
items.description: Your brand is applied on Aldaron's design system. You can also bring your own designer.

items.title: Maintenance
items.description: €150 to €400 per month, after the 30 days of bug fixes.

items.title: Code ownership
items.description: Code and accounts are handed over to you at launch.

items.title: External costs
items.description: Hosting and third-party services, store accounts: paid directly by you.

contact.title: Tell us about your product
contact.description: A few lines are enough to prepare the scoping.
